//Our referenced strings Hero Headquarters
Captain Knight A fearless hero who stands down to no one. His suit of armor is rumored to be impenetrable.
Shadow Rider You may not see him coming, but you will know when he has arrived. Beware of hiaow minions!
Hurricane A powerful hero who can summon the power of a storm. You cannot hide from the lightning.
Optimus 3000 AI has found its way to the battlefield. Not only can he fight, but any enemy electronics are under constant threat.
A.O.W. (Art of War) If he can draw it, expect it to be thrown at you. When the pen becomes the sword, no one is safe!
Big Claws Raised in the Jungle so no rules exist. The claws bring the stringest men nightmares.
Trident Titan He rules the ocean but can bring the fight anywhere. No one can hold their breath forever!
